import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('data/cameras.csv')

# Convert has_video_4k to categorical variable
data['has_video_4k'] = pd.Categorical(data['has_video_4k']).codes

# Create a violinplot to visualize the distribution of megapixels by brand
sns.set()
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10,6))
g = sns.violinplot(x='brand', y='megapixels', data=data, ax=ax)
ax.set_title('Distribution of Megapixels by Brand')
ax.set_xlabel('Brand')
ax.set_ylabel('Megapixels')
ax.legend(title='Sensor Type')
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
